description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Civil Procedure Code - Notification Under Section - 192
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka establishing the Legal Rate of Interest (15.15% per annum) effective from January 1, 2024. It is issued under the authority of the Civil Procedure Code and its amendments, making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification. The content involves setting a statutory financial rate rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
